# RAG vs parametric hallucination rates

## Findings

Retrieval-augmented models hallucinate less on factual questions when the
retrieved context is relevant, but can still fabricate when context is sparse.

## Methodology

We compared 20 RAG runs against 20 parametric runs on a held-out factual QA set.
